Requirements: For the B.S. degree in Accounting, a minimum of 120 credits is required. Entrance to the major requires a minimum cumulative grade-point average (GPA) and the completion of specific core courses with a grade of C or better, including: Financial and Managerial Accounting (ACCTG 211), Introductory Microeconomic Analysis and Policy (ECON 102), Rhetoric and Composition (ENGL 15 or ENGL 30), Techniques of Calculus I (MATH 110 or MATH 140), and Introduction to Statistics (SCM 200 or STAT 200). First-year applicants must submit a Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Accounting

Requirements: Entrance to the Acting major is by audition. Enrollment in the B.F.A. Acting program is limited. To be considered for admission, students must first apply to the University by completing the Penn State undergraduate application and also schedule an audition with the School of Theatre. For some programs, a pre-screening is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Acting

Requirements: Entrance to Major (ETM) Requirements: For entrance to the Actuarial Science major (ACTSC_BS), students must: (1) meet with an academic adviser and establish a plan of study; (2) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 3.20; and (3) complete the following courses with a grade of C or better: ACCTG 211, ECON 102, ENGL 15 or ENGL 30H, MATH 140, MATH 141, and STAT 200.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Actuarial Science

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Advertising/Public Relations major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29.1 credits; (2) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00; (3) have completed COMM 160 and COMM 180 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Advertising and Public Relations

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Aerospace Engineering major, a student must: (1) have completed MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, and CHEM 110 with a grade of C or better; (2) have completed at least two of the following: EMCH 211, EMCH 212, and/or MATH 220, MATH 230, MATH 231, MATH 250, MATH 251 with a grade of C or better; (3) have earned a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 3.00. This GPA requirement may change each year.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering

Requirements: First-year applicants to Penn State must submit the following for admission: an application (MyPennState or Common App), the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR), and standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) are optional through the Fall 2025 semester. High school unit requirements include: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of a World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in African American Studies

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the African Studies major, a student must: have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average. For the Bachelor of Arts degree in African Studies, a minimum of 123 credits is required, 24 of which must be at the 400 level.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in African Studies

Requirements: Entrance to the Agribusiness Management major requires a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00 and the completion of at least 29.1 credits. For first-year admission, applicants must meet the following high school unit requirements: four units of English, three units of mathematics (including algebra, geometry, and trigonometry), three units of science, three units of social studies, and two units of a single world language. Applicants must submit a high school transcript or Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Agribusiness Management

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade point average. The first two years of the program are designed to provide a sound foundation in the mathematical, physical, and biological sciences. During the third and fourth years, students complete the core requirements and select technical electives in their areas of interest. General undergraduate admission requires a completed application and the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems Management

Requirements: To be eligible for admission to the Agricultural and Extension Education major, students must: 1. have completed at least 29 credits; 2. have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00; 3. have completed ENGL 15 or ENGL 30; 4. have completed 3 credits of Mathematics (GQ).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Agricultural and Extension Education

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Agricultural Science major, a student must: 1) have completed at least 29 credits; 2) have a cumulative grade-point average of at least 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Agricultural Science

Requirements: First-year students are evaluated based on: High school GPA, Standardized test scores (SAT/ACT) are optional for students applying for admission through the fall 2025 semester, High school courses, Personal statement (optional). For Penn State University Park, the following high school units are required: 4 units of English, 3 units of math, 3 units of science, 3 units of social studies, and 2 units of the same world language. For all other campuses, the world language is not required but is recommended.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in American Studies

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Animal Science major, a student must have completed at least 29.1 credits and have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00. First-year applicants are evaluated on the basis of their high school record, including GPA and rigor of coursework. Penn State is currently test-optional, meaning standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) are not required for admission but may be submitted if the applicant chooses.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Animal Science

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Anthropological Science major, a student must: 1. attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade point average; 2. complete ANTH 21 GN(4) and ANTH 45(3) with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Anthropological Science

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Anthropology major, a student must: 1. have completed at least 29.5 cumulative credits; 2. have a cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Anthropology

Requirements: To apply for first-year admission, applicants must submit the Penn State application or the Common App, and the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). Standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) are optional for first-year students applying through the 2025-26 academic year. For entrance to the Anthropology BS major, students must have completed at least 29 credits with a cumulative grade-point average of at least 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Anthropology

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Architectural Engineering major, a student must satisfy the following requirements: 1. Be enrolled in the College of Engineering or the Division of Undergraduate Studies. 2. Have completed at least 29 graded Penn State credits. 3. Have completed with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211. 4. Have earned a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.60.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Architectural Engineering

Requirements: Admission to the professional B.Arch. degree program is based on high school rank and SAT (or ACT) scores. High school students apply during their senior year for admission into the five-year B.Arch. program. There is no portfolio review for admission to the first-year of the B.Arch. program. Transfer students apply to the department for admission to the program after they have applied to Penn State. The admissions procedure for transfer students into the Architecture program is based on a review of the student's college records and a portfolio of creative work.
Program name: Bachelor of Architecture in Architecture

Requirements: Admissions requirements for the Architecture major are listed on the Undergraduate Admissions website. To be considered for admission to the Bachelor of Science in Architecture, students must have a minimum of a high school diploma and meet the following high school unit requirements: 4 units of English, 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Math (including algebra, geometry, and trigonometry), and 2 units of a single world language. Applicants to the architecture program are not required to submit a portfolio of work.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Architecture

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Art (B.A.) major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed at least 24 credits. First-year students are admitted to the College of Arts and Architecture and typically apply for entrance to the major during their sophomore year. A portfolio is not required for admission to the B.A. in Art. Penn State is test-optional through the fall 2025 semester; first-year applicants can choose whether to submit SAT or ACT scores.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Art

Requirements: The B.F.A. in Art is a professional degree program that requires a portfolio review for admission. Portfolios are reviewed once each semester by a committee of the Art faculty. To be eligible for the portfolio review, students must have completed or be currently enrolled in ART 110, ART 111, ART 122Y, and ART 201 or ART 202, and have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Art

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Art Education major, a student must have: attained at least a 3.00 cumulative grade-point average; completed at least 48 collegiate-level credits; completed ENGL 15 or ENGL 30; 3 credits of literature (GH); and 6 credits of quantification (GQ); passed the PAPA or CORE exams or had them waived by qualifying SAT/ACT scores; submitted a portfolio of 10-12 pieces of original work for review by the Art Education faculty; participated in a personal interview with the Art Education faculty; submitted a one-page, typed statement of their professional goals.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Art Education

Requirements: Admission to the Art History major is based on the university’s standard undergraduate admission requirements. To be eligible for entrance to the Art History major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; and 2) satisfy any other requirements that may be established by the academic department. Standardized test scores are optional for first-year undergraduate applicants through the 2025-2026 academic year. Required high school coursework includes 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Art History

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Asian Studies major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2) be enrolled in or have completed at least 24 credits. Admissions to all undergraduate programs are processed by the Undergraduate Admissions Office. First-year and transfer students may apply for admission to the College of the Liberal Arts. For a Bachelor of Arts degree in Asian Studies, a minimum of 123 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Asian Studies

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and 2) satisfy the following course requirements: ASTRO 291, MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211. For first-year admission, applicants to the Eberly College of Science must have completed the following high school units: 4 units of English, 3.5 units of Mathematics (including algebra, geometry, and trigonometry), 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities, and 2 units of a single World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Astronomy and Astrophysics

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Biobehavioral Health major, a student must: 1. attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. have completed BBH 101 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Biobehavioral Health

Requirements: First-year applicants to Penn State must submit a completed application and the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). High school unit requirements include: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics (including algebra, geometry, and trigonometry), 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of a World Language. For the Eberly College of Science, additional emphasis is placed on math and science performance. Applicants can choose to submit SAT or ACT scores, but Penn State is test-optional through 2025.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to this major, students must satisfy the following requirements: pass the following courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211; have completed at least 29 earned Penn State credits (excludes transfer and AP credits); have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.60.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Biological Engineering

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Biology major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed BIOL 110 GN(4), CHEM 110 GN(3), and MATH 140 GQ(4) with a grade of C or better. Undergraduate admission also requires the completion of specific high school units: 4 units of English, 3 units of social studies, 3 units of science, 3 units of math (algebra, geometry, trigonometry, or higher), and 2 units of a single world language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Biology

Requirements: For the B.S. degree in Biomedical Engineering, a minimum of 129 credits is required. Entry to the Biomedical Engineering major occurs during the spring semester of the sophomore year. Students must complete the following entrance-to-major requirements: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211 with a grade of C or better. At least a 3.00 cumulative Penn State grade-point average is required. High school students should have a minimum of 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics (including algebra, geometry, and trigonometry), 3 units of science, and 3 units of social studies/art/humanities.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Engineering

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Biorenewable Systems major, a student must have: 1) attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Biorenewable Systems

Requirements: For entrance into the Biotechnology major, there are no additional requirements beyond those for admission to the University. The first-year admission process is based on a variety of factors, including high school grades and coursework, standardized test scores (SAT/ACT), and other information provided in the application. For transfer students, applicants who have completed at least 18 credits may be considered for admission.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Biotechnology

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Business major, a student must: 1) have completed the following entrance-to-major requirements with a grade of C or better: MATH 110 GQ(3) or MATH 140 GQ(4), ACCTG 211(4), ECON 102 GS(3), SCM 200 GQ(4) or STAT 200 GQ(4); 2) have achieved a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Business

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Chemical Engineering major, a student must: 1) have completed the following entrance-to-major requirements with a grade of C or better in each: CHEM 110, CHEM 111, CHEM 112, MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211; 2) have achieved a cumulative grade-point average (GPA) of 2.60 or higher.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; completed CHEM 110, CHEM 111, CHEM 112, MATH 140, and MATH 141 and earned a grade of C or better in each of these courses. General high school requirements for Penn State include: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of a World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Chemistry

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Chinese major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed CHNS 1, CHNS 2, and CHNS 3 or equivalent. For the B.A. degree in Chinese, a minimum of 123 credits is required. For more information about the admission process, students should visit the Office of Undergraduate Admissions website.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Chinese

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Civil Engineering major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.60 cumulative grade-point average; completed the following entrance-to-major courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211. Students must apply for entrance to the major during the semester in which they are completing their entrance-to-major requirements, typically the spring of the sophomore year.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average. First-year students who wish to start at University Park are admitted to the DUS (Division of Undergraduate Studies) or to the College of the Liberal Arts. Admission to the Bachelor of Arts in Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies requires only that students are admitted to the College of the Liberal Arts and meet the criteria for entrance to the major.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Classics and Ancient Mediterranean Studies

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Communication Arts and Sciences major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average. 2) have completed CAS 101 with a grade of C or better. 3) have completed CAS 201 or CAS 202 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Communication Arts and Sciences

Requirements: Admission to the Communication Arts and Sciences major (CAS) is available to any student who has been admitted to the University and who is in good standing. Entering students are typically admitted to the College of the Liberal Arts and then apply for the CAS major during their sophomore year when they have completed 29 credits and earned a 2.0 or higher cumulative GPA. In addition to a cumulative 2.0 GPA, students must have completed CAS 101.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Communication Arts and Sciences

Requirements: First-year students can apply to Penn State through the Undergraduate Admissions Office and can choose Communication Sciences and Disorders (CSD) as their major on the application. Evaluation for admission is based on a variety of factors, including high school GPA, high school coursework (specifically completion of required high school units), and standardized test scores if the student chooses to submit them. Required high school units include four units of English, three units of mathematics, three units of science, and three units of social studies, arts, or humanities.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Communication Sciences and Disorders

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average. For general undergraduate admission, applicants must have a high school diploma or its equivalent. Required high school coursework includes 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Community, Environment, and Development

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Comparative Literature major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade point average. For the B.A. degree in Comparative Literature, a minimum of 120 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Comparative Literature

Requirements: To be considered for first-year admission to Penn State, applicants must provide their high school records (official transcripts or Self-Reported Academic Record). General high school unit requirements include 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, and 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities. For the Computer Engineering program in the College of Engineering, a minimum of 1/2 unit of trigonometry or higher-level math is specifically required. Penn State is currently test-optional through the Fall 2025 semester.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Computer Science major, a student must: have completed MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, and CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131 with a grade of C or better; have earned a minimum cumulative grade-point average. General first-year admission requires high school graduation or GED, and the completion of specific high school units including 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities, and 2 units of World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

Requirements: To be eligible for admission to the Computer Science major, students must: 1. Have completed the following courses with a grade of C or better: CMPSC 121 or CMPSC 131, CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132, MATH 140, MATH 141. 2. Have a cumulative grade-point average of 2.00 or higher. General first-year admission requirements include the completion of the following high school units: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities, and 2 units of a single World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science

Requirements: Entrance to the Corporate Innovation and Entrepreneurship major is competitive and based on specific criteria including successful completion of administrative requirements, credit count, grade-point average, and specific courses. To be eligible for entrance to the Corporate Innovation and Entrepreneurship major, students must: (1) have completed at least 44 cumulative credits at Penn State but not more than 59 cumulative credits at Penn State (this includes current-semester credits in progress) at the time of application for entrance to the major; (2) have a cumulative grade-point average of 3.20 or higher; (3) have completed the following entrance-to-major courses with a grade of C or better: ACCTG 211, ECON 102, ENGL 15 or ENGL 30H, FIN 301, MATH 110 or MATH 140, MGMT 301, MKTG 301, SCM 301, and STAT 200.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Corporate Innovation and Entrepreneurship

Requirements: To be considered for first-year admission to Penn State, applicants must have completed a minimum of 15 high school units, including: 4 units of English (including 1 unit of composition or rhetoric), 3 units of mathematics (including algebra, geometry, and a second year of algebra), 3 units of science (including 2 units of natural science), 3 units of social studies (including 1 unit of world history or geography), and 2 units of the same world language. Additionally, to be eligible for entrance to the Creative Writing major, a student must have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and completed at least 29.1 credits. The B.F.A. in Creative Writing requires a total of 120 credits for graduation. Penn State is test-optional through Fall 2025.
Program name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Creative Writing

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Criminology major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29.1 credits; (2) have achieved at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; (3) have completed CRIM 100(3), SOC 110(3) or STAT 200(4), and one of the following: CRIM 249(3), CRIM 250W(3), or CRIM 406(3), all with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Criminology

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Criminology major (CRIMB_BS), a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade point average. For general undergraduate admission to Penn State, applicants must provide a completed application, the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR), and meet high school unit requirements including 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Criminology

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Cybersecurity Analytics and Operations major, students must satisfy the following requirements: 1. Attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average. 2. Complete the following entrance-to-major courses with a grade of C or better: MATH 110 GQ or MATH 140 GQ; IST 210, IST 220, IST 242 (or CMPSC 122 or CMPSC 132), and STAT 200 GQ or SCM 200 GQ.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity Analytics and Operations

Requirements: To apply for the Bachelor of Science in Data Sciences, first-year applicants must submit an online application (via MyPennState or the Common App) and the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). Penn State is test-optional through 2025, meaning SAT or ACT scores are not required for admission. The most important factor in the review of an application is the high school academic record, specifically grades and course rigor.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Data Sciences

Requirements: Entrance to the Digital Arts and Media Design (DART) major is a two-step process. Step 1: All students must first apply to the university through the Penn State Undergraduate Admissions Office. Step 2: Applicants must also complete a portfolio review for the Digital Arts and Media Design major. Information regarding the portfolio review process and deadlines is available on the program's website. For the B.Des. degree in Digital Arts and Media Design, a minimum of 120 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Design in Digital Arts and Media Design

Requirements: To be eligible for admission to the Bachelor of Design in Digital Multimedia Design, students must meet the general University admission requirements, which include a high school diploma or equivalent and the completion of specific high school units. This program is available to both first-year and transfer students. Notably, a portfolio review is not required for admission to this major.
Program name: Bachelor of Design in Digital Multimedia Design

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1. have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. have completed at least 29.1 credits and be at least a third-semester student. Students must apply for admission to the college by following the procedures described on the Penn State Admissions website.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Earth Science and Policy

Requirements: For the B.S. degree in Earth Sciences, a minimum of 120 credits is required. In order to be eligible for entrance to the Earth Sciences major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2) complete the following courses with a grade of C or better: EARTH 100, GEOSC 1, GEOSC 20, or METEO 3. First-year applicants to Penn State must submit: Penn State application, Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR) or high school transcript, and optional SAT or ACT scores.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Earth Sciences

Requirements: To be eligible for admission to Penn State as a first-year student, you must have graduated from high school or have a GED. The following high school units are required for all students: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics (Algebra 1, Algebra 2, and Geometry), 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies/Art/Humanities, and 2 units of a single World Language. Admission to the East Asian Studies major is available to students who have been admitted to the College of the Liberal Arts.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in East Asian Studies

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Economics major, a student must have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and completed and earned a grade of C or better in ECON 102 GS(3), ECON 104 GS(3), MATH 110 GQ(4) or MATH 140 GQ(4). For the Bachelor of Arts degree in Economics, a minimum of 120 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Economics

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Economics (ECNBS) major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed and earned a grade of C or better in: ECON 102 GS(3), ECON 104 GS(3), MATH 110 GQ(4) or MATH 140 GQ(4).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Economics

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Electrical Engineering major, a student must: 1. have completed the following entrance-to-major courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, PHYS 212. 2. have attained at least a 2.60 cumulative grade-point average (on a 4.00 scale) and at least third-semester classification (29.1 credits). Additionally, applicants to the College of Engineering must have completed 1/2 unit of trigonometry or higher level math (pre-calculus, calculus) in high school.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, students must satisfy the following requirements: 1. Completed the requirements for the Associate in Engineering Technology in Electrical Engineering Technology degree or its equivalent. 2. A minimum cumulative grade point average of 2.00. For the Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering Technology degree, a minimum of 127 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering Technology

Requirements: Entrance to the Electro-Mechanical Engineering Technology major requires the completion of at least 29 credits and a minimum 2.00 cumulative grade-point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Electro-Mechanical Engineering Technology

Requirements: Applicants must submit a completed undergraduate application and the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). Standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) are currently optional for undergraduate admission. To be formally admitted into the Elementary and Early Childhood Education major, students must meet 'Entrance to Major' requirements, which typically occur after completing 48-60 credits at Penn State. These requirements include a minimum 3.00 cumulative grade-point average and the completion of specific core courses in English and Mathematics.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Elementary and Early Childhood Education

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Energy and Sustainability Policy major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed no fewer than 29.1 cumulative credits. General first-year admission requires a high school diploma or equivalent and the completion of required high school units including 4 years of English, 3 years of mathematics, 3 years of science, 3 years of social studies, and 2 years of a single world language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Energy and Sustainability Policy

Requirements: Incoming first-year students who meet the current Penn State admission criteria will be admitted directly into the major. Penn State undergraduate students may be admitted to the major after they have satisfied the following requirements: (1) have completed at least 29.1 credits and (2) have a cumulative grade-point average of at least 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Energy and Sustainability Policy

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Energy Business and Finance major, a student must: (1) have completed the following entrance-to-major requirements with a grade of C or better in each course: ECON 102 GS(3), MATH 140 GQ(4) and (2) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Energy Business and Finance

Requirements: For the B.S. degree in Energy Engineering, a student must be granted admission to the major. Entrance to the Energy Engineering major requires that the student has: 1. completed the following courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211; 2. earned a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Energy Engineering

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the English major, a student must: 1. have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. have completed ENGL 15 or ENGL 30H with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in English

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1. attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average. For the Bachelor of Science degree in Enterprise Technology Integration, a minimum of 120 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Enterprise Technology Integration

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Environmental Resource Management major, a student must: 1. have completed the following entrance-to-major requirements: BIOL 110 or CHEM 110 or ECON 102, MATH 110 or MATH 140; 2. have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00. Additionally, freshman applicants must meet high school unit requirements: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities, and 2 units of a single World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Resource Management

Requirements: Entrance to the Environmental Systems Engineering major requires the completion of at least 29 credits and a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00. Additionally, students must complete MATH 140, MATH 141, CHEM 110, and PHYS 211 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Environmental Systems Engineering

Requirements: Admission to the Film Production major is a two-step process. First, students must be admitted to the Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications. Second, enrollment in the Film Production major is limited. Students apply for admission to the major after completing at least three semesters of study at Penn State and the two prerequisite courses: COMM 150 and COMM 242. Admission to the major is competitive and based on a review of the student's creative work and academic record.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Film Production

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Finance major, students must enroll in the Smeal College of Business or the Division of Undergraduate Studies and must complete the following entrance-to-major requirements: ACCTG 211(4) or ACCTG 211H(4), ECON 102(3) or ECON 102H(3), ENGL 15 GWS(3) or ENGL 30 GWS(3) or ENGL 137H GWS(3) or CAS 137H GWS(3), MATH 110 GQ(4) or MATH 140 GQ(4) or MATH 110H GQ(4) or MATH 140H GQ(4), STAT 200 GQ(4) or SCM 200 GQ(4) or SCM 200H GQ(4). All these courses must be completed with a grade of C or better. Students must have a minimum cumulative grade-point average that is set annually.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Finance

Requirements: Graduates of a high school or those who have earned a GED may be eligible for admission to the first-year class. Requirements for admission to the University are a high school diploma or GED and the following high school units: 4 units of English; 3 units of mathematics (algebra, geometry, trigonometry, or higher math); 3 units of science; 3 units of social studies; 2 units of the same second language. In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, students must satisfy the following requirements: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; completed the following courses and earned a grade of C or better in each: CHEM 110, CHEM 111, CHEM 112, MATH 110 or MATH 140.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Food Science

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Forensic Science major, a student must: 1. have completed the following entrance-to-major requirements with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, CHEM 111, CHEM 112, FRNSC 210, and MATH 140; 2. have earned a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Forensic Science

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the French and Francophone Studies major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29.1 credits; (2) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00. For first-year admission, applicants are evaluated on their high school GPA and completion of required high school coursework (including 4 units of English, 3 units of Math, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of World Language).
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in French and Francophone Studies

Requirements: Admissions requirements for the Bachelor of Science in Geography are consistent with the requirements for the College of Earth and Mineral Sciences. To be eligible for admission to the Geography major, students must be enrolled in the College of Earth and Mineral Sciences or the Division of Undergraduate Studies (DUS). For admission to the University, first-year applicants must have a high school diploma or its equivalent and have completed a minimum of 15 units of preparatory work, including 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of a single world language other than English.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Geography

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, students must satisfy the following requirements: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Geography

Requirements: Entrance to the Geosciences major requires that a student have: (1) completed at least 29 credits; (2) earned a cumulative grade-point average of at least 2.00; and (3) completed GEOSC 1, GEOSC 20, or GEOSC 71; and CHEM 110 and MATH 140, each with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Geosciences

Requirements: For entrance into the major, students must have a cumulative grade-point average of 2.0 or higher.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in German

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Global and International Studies major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed at least 27.5 credits. For Penn State's general admission requirements, freshman applicants must submit Penn State’s undergraduate application, official high school transcripts or GED, and SAT or ACT scores (optional through 2025).
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Global and International Studies

Requirements: Applicants must apply to the University through the Undergraduate Admissions Office. In addition to the University's high school graduation requirements, the College of the Liberal Arts requires two units of a single world language other than English. To be eligible for entrance to the Global and International Studies major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29.1 credits and be enrolled in or have completed his/her fourth semester; (2) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00; and (3) have completed GLIS 101 or GLIS 102 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Global and International Studies

Requirements: Admission to the Graphic Design major is a two-step process. First-year students must first apply to Penn State and then submit a portfolio to the Stuckeman School via SlideRoom. Admission is based on a review of the student’s academic record and the portfolio.
Program name: Bachelor of Design in Graphic Design

Requirements: First-year applicants must complete a minimum of 15 units of high school coursework, including 4 units of English, 3 units of Social Studies, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Math (specifically Algebra 1, Algebra 2, and Geometry or Trigonometry), and 2 units of a single world language. Evaluation for admission is primarily based on the student's high school academic record (GPA) and the completion of these required subjects. Penn State is currently test-optional through the fall 2025 semester.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Health Policy and Administration

Requirements: To be considered for first-year admission to Penn State, applicants must complete high school course requirements, which include four units of English, three units of social studies, three units of science, and three units of math (algebra, geometry, and trigonometry). Applicants must also submit a Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). Standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) are optional. For entrance to the History (B.A.) major specifically at Abington, students must satisfy a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in History

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2) satisfy the third semester classification; 3) complete the following entrance-to-major requirements with a grade of C or better: ACCTG 211, ECON 102, HM 201. Standard Penn State undergraduate admission requirements also apply, including the submission of a high school transcript and optional standardized test scores.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1. attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. be in at least their third semester (at least 27.1 credits). For the Bachelor of Science degree in Human Development and Family Studies, a minimum of 120 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Human Development and Family Studies

Requirements: Entrance to Major: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Human Resource Management major, a student must: 1. attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. have completed ECON 102 GS(3), PSYCH 100 GS(3), and STAT 200 GQ(4) or SCM 200 GQ(4), and earned a grade of C or better in each of these courses. To be eligible for admission to the College of the Liberal Arts, an applicant must have completed: 2 units of a single world language other than English.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Human Resource Management

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Industrial Engineering major, students must have completed 29-55 cumulative credits at Penn State; have an overall cumulative grade-point average of 2.60 or higher; and have completed the following courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Information Sciences and Technology major, a student must: 1) attain a cumulative grade-point average of 2.00 or higher; and 2) complete the following courses with a grade of C or better: IST 110, IST 140 (or CMPSC 101 or CMPSC 121), IST 210, and IST 220. General first-year admission to the university requires the completion of specific high school units, including four units of English, three units of Mathematics (algebra, geometry, and trigonometry/pre-calculus), three units of Science, three units of Social Studies, and two units of a World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Information Sciences and Technology

Requirements: Our Bachelor of Science in Integrated Social Sciences is a flexible degree program that gives you the tools to explore how the world works across a variety of social science disciplines. Working with a dedicated program director, you can customize your coursework to match your specific interests while following a rigorous academic path. Students will gain knowledge in research methods, ethics, and critical thinking. They will also be able to communicate effectively in a variety of formats.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Integrated Social Sciences

Requirements: Entrance to the Integrative Science major (ISCI_BS) requires the following: Cumulative grade point average of at least 2.00. Standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) are not required for students applying for undergraduate admission through the 2025-26 academic year.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Integrative Science

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Interdisciplinary Business with Engineering Studies major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and completed: MATH 140, ECON 102, CHEM 110 and ACCTG 211 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Interdisciplinary Business with Engineering Studies

Requirements: The Interdisciplinary Science and Business (ISB) degree, offered by the School of Science and the Black School of Business, allows students to prepare for careers in the 21st-century business and technology environment. This program provides students with a solid foundation in the physical and life sciences and a thorough understanding of the business principles needed to manage modern technology. Graduation requirements include 121 credits, and students must complete coursework in science, business, and engineering. For more information, please contact the B.S. in Interdisciplinary Science and Business program at 814-898-6105 or email behrend-science@psu.edu.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Interdisciplinary Science and Business

Requirements: International Business is a secondary major. To graduate with a major in International Business, a student must also complete a primary major in the Smeal College of Business. Entrance to the International Business major occurs at the same time as entrance to the primary Smeal major. To be eligible for the International Business major, a student must be enrolled in the Smeal College of Business or the Division of Undergraduate Studies. Students must have completed 29-59 cumulative credits at Penn State and have a cumulative grade-point average of 3.20. In addition to the GPA and credit requirements, students must also: 1. Complete or be currently enrolled in the following entrance-to-major courses: ACCTG 211, ECON 102, ENGL 15 or ENGL 30, MATH 110 or MATH 140, STAT 200 or SCM 200. 2. Demonstrate proficiency in a contemporary foreign language. 3. Submit an application for the major.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in International Business

Requirements: Entrance to Major: In order to be eligible for entrance to the International Politics major, a student must: 1. attain at least a C (2.00) cumulative grade-point average for all courses taken at the University; and 2. have at least third-semester classification (a minimum of 44 credits). For a first-year student to be eligible for admission to the College of the Liberal Arts, an applicant must have a high school diploma or its equivalent and have completed the following units: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics (algebra, geometry, and trigonometry or higher math), 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities, and 2 units of a single world language.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in International Politics

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Italian major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and completed or be currently enrolled in IT 3 or IT 10.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Italian

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Japanese major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29.1 credits and be enrolled in or have completed no more than 60 credits; (2) have completed JAPNS 1, JAPNS 2, and JAPNS 3; (3) have earned at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Japanese

Requirements: This program currently has no additional requirements for entrance to the major. For Penn State's admissions requirements, visit the Admissions website. First-year admission to Penn State is based on several factors, including: High school coursework, Grades, Standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) – optional through Fall 2025.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Jewish Studies

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Journalism major, a student must: (1) have completed COMM 160 with a grade of C or better; (2) have completed at least 27.5 cumulative credits; and (3) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Journalism

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Kinesiology major, a student must have: 1) attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2) completed the following entrance-to-major requirements with a grade of C or better: BIOL 110 GN(4), KINES 100(3), KINES 101(3), PSYCH 100 GS(3) and one of the following: BIOL 161 GN(3) or BIOL 141 GN(3).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Kinesiology

Requirements: To be eligible for first-year admission to the Bachelor of Arts in Labor and Human Resources at Penn State, applicants must meet the university's general undergraduate admission requirements. These include the completion of specific high school units: 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics, 3 units of science, 3 units of social studies, and 2 units of a single world language. Admission decisions are primarily based on a student's academic record in high school, including grade point average (GPA) and the rigor of the curriculum.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Labor and Human Resources

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Labor and Human Resources major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29.1 cumulative credits; (2) have a cumulative grade-point average of at least 2.00; and (3) have completed the following courses with a grade of C or better: LHR 100.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Labor and Human Resources

Requirements: The Bachelor of Landscape Architecture (B.L.A.) is a five-year professional degree program, fully accredited by the Landscape Architecture Accreditation Board (LAAB). Admissions to the Bachelor of Landscape Architecture program are handled through the Undergraduate Admissions Office. To be eligible for entrance to the Bachelor of Landscape Architecture major, a student must: (1) have completed the admission requirements of the University and the College of Arts and Architecture; (2) have a cumulative grade-point average of 2.00 or higher.
Program name: Bachelor of Landscape Architecture in Landscape Architecture

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Latin American Studies major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average. For admission to the University, undergraduate applicants must submit an application, official high school transcripts or a Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR), and have completed specific high school units including 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of a single World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Latin American Studies

Requirements: Entrance to Major: No additional requirements for admission to this major. For more information about the admission process, students should visit the Undergraduate Admissions website.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Law and Society

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Letters, Arts, and Sciences major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 27.5 credits; (2) have a cumulative grade-point average of at least 2.00; and (3) submit a proposal for the major. The proposal must be developed in consultation with a faculty advisor. The proposal must include: (1) a statement of the student's goals; (2) a list of the courses that will be used to meet the requirements for the major; and (3) a rationale for how the courses will help the student meet their goals.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Letters, Arts, and Sciences

Requirements: Requirements for admission to the University as a first-year student include a high school diploma or equivalent and the completion of the following high school units: 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics, 3 units of science, 3 units of social studies, and 2 units of the same world language. Penn State is test-optional through fall 2025.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Linguistics

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Management major, students must: 1. obtain a cumulative grade-point average (GPA) of 2.00 or higher; 2. complete and earn a grade of C or better in: ACCTG 211, ECON 102, ENGL 15 or ENGL 30H or ESL 15, MATH 110 or MATH 140, and STAT 200 or SCM 200.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Management

Requirements: To apply for the Bachelor of Science in Management Information Systems at Penn State, first-year applicants must submit an online application (via Penn State’s MyPennState portal or the Common App) and a Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). Standardized test scores (SAT or ACT) are optional through the Fall 2025 application cycle. Penn State does not require letters of recommendation, a resume, or a writing sample as part of the undergraduate application process. While an optional personal statement is available within the application, it is not required.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Management Information Systems

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Marketing major, students must: 1) attain a cumulative grade-point average of 3.20 or higher; 2) complete the following entrance-to-major courses with a grade of C or better: ACCTG 211, ECON 102, ENGL 15 or ENGL 30, MATH 110 or MATH 140, MGMT 301, MKTG 301, and SCM 301; and 3) have completed at least 44 but no more than 59 cumulative credits at Penn State. High school requirements for admission include 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science/Social Studies, and 2 units of a single World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Marketing

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Materials Science and Engineering major, a student must: 1. Have completed the following entrance-to-major courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211. 2. Have a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.00. General application requirements include the completion of the Penn State application or Common App, the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR), and standardized test scores (SAT or ACT), which are optional through the fall 2025 semester.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Materials Science and Engineering

Requirements: Applicants must have a high school diploma or its equivalent. General freshman admission requirements include 15 secondary school units: 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics (including algebra, geometry, and algebra 2), 3 units of science, 3 units of social studies, and 2 units of a single world language. For entrance to the Mathematics major, a student must have: 1) attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2) completed MATH 140 and MATH 141 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Mathematics

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Mathematics major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed MATH 140 and MATH 141 with a grade of C or better. General first-year admission requires a high school diploma or equivalent and the completion of specific high school units including English, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies, and World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Mathematics

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to this major, students must satisfy the following requirements: 1. A minimum cumulative grade point average of 2.60. 2. Completion of the following courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211. General freshman admission requires the submission of an official high school transcript or equivalent.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering

Requirements: To be eligible for the Mechanical Engineering Technology major, a student must have earned a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00 and completed MET 107, MET 111, MATH 022, and MATH 026 or MATH 040 or MATH 041 or MATH 081 or MATH 140. General first-year admission requirements for Penn State Behrend include 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics (algebra, geometry, trigonometry), 3 units of science, 3 units of social studies, and 2 units of a single world language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering Technology

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Media Studies major, a student must: 1. have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. have completed at least 29.1 credits.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Media Studies

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must have achieved a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00 and have completed the following entrance-to-major requirements: MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211. General high school requirements for freshman admission include 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics (algebra, geometry, and trigonometry/pre-calculus), 3 units of science, 3 units of social studies/arts/humanities, and 2 units of a single world language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Meteorology and Atmospheric Science

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Microbiology major, a student must: 1) attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2) completed MICRB 201(3) or MICRB 202(2) and earned a grade of C or better. Freshman Students: Information on the Penn State admission process for first-year students can be found on the Admissions section of the Bulletin. Transfer Students: Information on the Penn State admission process for transfer students can be found on the Admissions section of the Bulletin.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Microbiology

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Middle Level Education major, a student must: 1. Attain at least a 3.00 cumulative grade point average. 2. Complete at least 48 units of transferable college-level credit. 3. Pass the Basic Skills Requirement. 4. Complete ENGL 15 GWS or ENGL 30 GWS, 3 credits of literature, and MATH 200 and MATH 201. 5. Complete EDPSY 14.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Middle Level Education

Requirements: Entrance to Major (ETM) Requirements: In addition to the University requirements for entrance to a major, the College of Earth and Mineral Sciences requires that students complete MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, and CHEM 110 with a grade of C or better. Students may spend their first two years at any Penn State campus and then finish the final two years at University Park or Fayette.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Mining Engineering

Requirements: In addition to the application for admission to the University, students must also submit a School of Music application and complete an audition on a band or orchestral instrument, piano, organ, or voice. Entrance to the major occurs upon completion of at least 29.1 credits, with a minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA and a successful performance audition.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Music

Requirements: Entrance to the Bachelor of Music (B.M.) major requires a successful performance audition on a standard orchestral or band instrument, piano, organ, classical guitar, or voice. Audition requirements are available on the School of Music website. In addition to the audition, students must also complete the University application for admission. Students are admitted to the program only after a successful audition has been completed and they have been admitted to the University.
Program name: Bachelor of Music in Music

Requirements: To be considered for admission to the Bachelor of Music Education program, applicants must first apply for undergraduate admission to Penn State. Once the University application is submitted and a Penn State ID number is received, applicants must submit the School of Music supplemental application to schedule an audition. Required components for the School of Music application include a successful performance audition on a primary instrument or voice, an interview with music education faculty, and a brief essay (statement of intent) explaining the applicant's choice of music education as a career. A resume of musical background and activities is also required as part of the supplemental application.
Program name: Bachelor of Music Education in Music Education

Requirements: Entrance to the Musical Arts major requires a successful audition on an instrument or voice. In addition to the audition, students must submit a personal statement (maximum 500 words) describing their interest in the Bachelor of Musical Arts degree, as well as two letters of recommendation from music professionals. For some students, an interview or a portfolio review may be required.
Program name: Bachelor of Musical Arts in Musical Arts

Requirements: Admission to the Musical Theatre option is based on an audition. Potential students must first be admitted to the university and then audition for the program. The audition process involves a pre-screen submission including a resume, headshot, and performance videos. Candidates who pass the pre-screen are invited to a final audition consisting of singing, acting, and dance components.
Program name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Musical Theatre

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Nuclear Engineering major, students must satisfy the following requirements: 29-55 cumulative credits (one semester in residence at Penn State); 2.60 cumulative grade-point average; and completion of MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, and CHEM 110 with a grade of C or better.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Nuclear Engineering

Requirements: Admission to the Nursing major is competitive. Review factors include the high school grade-point average and high school coursework. Review of applications for the Nursing major begins in early November. First-year students who select the Nursing major on their application will be reviewed for admission to the College of Nursing. High school students are required to have: 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics (algebra, geometry, and trigonometry or higher math), 3 units of science, and 3 units of social studies, humanities, or the arts. In addition, two units of the same world language other than English are required.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Nursing

Requirements: First-year students who meet the university admission requirements are admitted directly into the major. High school unit requirements include: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics (Algebra, Geometry, and Trigonometry), 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, Arts, or Humanities, and 2 units of a single World Language. Penn State is currently test-optional through the Fall 2025 semester. To be eligible for entrance to the Nutritional Sciences major, a student must have a cumulative grade-point average of at least 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Nutritional Sciences

Requirements: For information about the Penn State application process, please visit the Office of Undergraduate Admissions website. To be eligible for entrance to the Organizational Leadership major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Organizational Leadership

Requirements: Penn State reviews applications for first-year and transfer admission based on a variety of factors, including high school GPA, high school coursework, and standardized test scores (if submitted). For transfer students, the primary consideration is the student’s academic record at previous colleges or universities. High school students are expected to complete specific units of study, including English, Social Studies, Science, Arts/Humanities, and Mathematics (Algebra 1, Algebra 2, and Geometry/Trigonometry).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Organizational Leadership

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, students must satisfy the following requirements: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; completed MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, and CHEM 110 with a grade of C or better. General undergraduate admission also requires the completion of specific high school units: 4 units of English, 3 units of social studies, 3 units of science, 3 units of math (algebra, geometry, and trigonometry), and 2 units of a single world language.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Petroleum and Natural Gas Engineering

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1. complete the following entrance to major course with a grade of C or better: PHIL 1 or PHIL 2 or PHIL 12 or PHIL 13; 2. have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Philosophy

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Physics major, a student must have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and completed MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, and PHYS 212 and earned a grade of C or better in each of these courses. General first-year admission requirements include the completion of specific high school units: 4 units of English, 3 units of mathematics (algebra, geometry, and trigonometry), 3 units of science, 3 units of social studies, and 2 units of a single world language. Applicants must also provide high school transcripts or a Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Physics

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1. attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and 2. have completed MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211, and PHYS 212, and earned at least a grade of C in each of these courses.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Planetary Science and Astronomy

Requirements: Entrance to the Plant Sciences major requires a 2.00 or higher cumulative grade-point average. For first-year admission, Penn State requires a completed application and high school transcripts. The university is test-optional for the 2024 and 2025 application cycles, meaning SAT or ACT scores are not required but may be submitted for consideration.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Plant Sciences

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Political Science major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. completed PLSC 1, PLSC 3, PLSC 7, or PLSC 14 with a grade of C or better. For the B.A. degree in Political Science, a minimum of 123 credits is required.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Political Science major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29 credits; (2) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00; (3) have completed and earned a grade of C or better in at least two of the following: PLSC 1, PLSC 3, PLSC 7, PLSC 14; and (4) have completed and earned a grade of C or better in 3 credits of GH, GS, or GHW.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Political Science

Requirements: For the Materials Science and Engineering major (which offers an emphasis in Polymer Science and Engineering), first-year applicants must meet Penn State's general undergraduate admission requirements, including submission of a high school transcript or equivalent and the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). For students seeking entrance to the major, specific requirements include the completion of CHEM 110, MATH 140, MATH 141, and PHYS 211 with a grade of C or better and a minimum cumulative grade-point average (GPA) of 2.00. Additionally, Penn State is test-optional through the Fall 2025 semester, meaning standardized test scores are not required for admission.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Polymer Science and Engineering

Requirements: To be considered for the Premedical-Medical program, a student must be in their final year of high school. In addition to completing the Penn State application, a student must submit an official SAT or ACT score (the SAT/ACT requirement is not optional for this program). Admission to this program is highly selective. The most successful applicants have: A minimum combined SAT score of 1470 (Evidence-based Reading and Writing + Math) OR a composite ACT score of 32; Rank in the top 10 percent of their high school graduating class; and Significant volunteer or work experience in a healthcare setting. After an initial review, a select group of applicants will be invited to complete the second phase of the application process, which includes an additional application, three letters of recommendation, and a personal statement.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Premedical-Medical

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1) attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and 2) complete the following courses with a grade of C or better: CHEM 110, CHEM 111, CHEM 112, CHEM 113, MATH 140, MATH 141.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Premedicine

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Professional Photography major, a student must: 1. attain at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; 2. satisfy any other entrance requirements for the major. Administrative Enrollment Controls are initiated when student demand exceeds the capacity of a program's faculty or facilities. Students must have completed a certain number of credits and have a specific grade point average for admission.
Program name: Bachelor of Design in Professional Photography

Requirements: To apply for undergraduate admission to the Bachelor of Science in Project and Supply Chain Management, students must submit an application through MyPennState or the Common App, and provide a Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). Penn State is test-optional for students applying through the fall 2025 semester. For entrance to the major, students typically must complete specific prerequisite courses, including MATH 110 or MATH 140, STAT 200 or SCM 200, and ENGL 15 or ENGL 30H, with a grade of C or better, and meet minimum cumulative GPA requirements.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Project and Supply Chain Management

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Psychology major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; completed PSYCH 100 with a grade of C or better; and completed one of the following with a grade of C or better: STAT 200, SOC 1, or PSYCH 100. Applicants must also meet general high school unit requirements, which include 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of World Language.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Psychology

Requirements: First-year applicants must submit the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR) and meet specific high school unit requirements: 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics (including algebra, geometry, and trigonometry or higher math), 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies/Arts/Humanities, and 2 units of a single World Language. For formal entrance to the Psychology B.S. major, students must complete PSY 100, STAT 200 or PSY 200, and one additional 200-level PSY course (such as PSY 212, PSY 221, or PSY 231) with a grade of C or better, and maintain a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Psychology

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Public Policy major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Public Policy

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, students must satisfy the following requirements: be enrolled in the College of Health and Human Development or the Division of Undergraduate Studies. have completed the following: ENGL 15 or ENGL 30H; and 3 credits from the following: STAT 200, PSYCH 200, or SOC 7.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Recreation, Park, and Tourism Management

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to this major, a student must: 1. have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average; and 2. have at least third-semester classification (at least 29.1 credits). For information on the Penn State admission process, please visit the Undergraduate Admissions website.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Rehabilitation and Human Services

Requirements: To apply for undergraduate admission at Penn State, first-year applicants must submit an application (either via MyPennState or the Common App) and their official high school transcripts (Self-Reported Academic Record). For the 2025-26 academic year, Penn State is test-optional, meaning students may choose whether or not to submit SAT or ACT scores for consideration.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies

Requirements: Entrance to the Risk Management major occurs during the spring semester of the student's sophomore year. A student must have: (1) attained at least a 3.20 cumulative grade point average (this GPA is subject to change each year); (2) completed or be currently enrolled in all entrance-to-major courses; (3) completed at least 44 cumulative credits at Penn State; and (4) submitted an application for the major through LionPATH. The following entrance-to-major courses must be completed with a grade of C or better: MATH 110 or MATH 140, ACCTG 211, ECON 102, ENGL 15 or ENGL 30, MGMT 301, MKTG 301, STAT 200 or SCM 200.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Risk Management

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Russian major, a student must have: 1. attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade point average; 2. completed at least 29.1 credits. For the B.A. degree in Russian, a minimum of 120 credits is required. For Penn State's general admission requirements, please visit the Undergraduate Admissions website.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Russian

Requirements: To be considered for first-year admission to Penn State, applicants must submit the online application and the Self-Reported Academic Record (SRAR). Penn State is test-optional through the fall 2025 semester; first-year applicants can choose whether to submit SAT or ACT scores. For students already enrolled at the university, entry to the Science (SCIBC) major requires a 2.00 or higher cumulative grade-point average and at least 29.1 credits.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Science

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Secondary Education major, a student must: 1) have completed at least 27.1 credits and have a cumulative grade-point average of 3.00; 2) have completed CI 280 and EDPSY 14 with a grade of C or better; 3) provide evidence of 80 hours of volunteer or paid service with learners of the age group the candidate plans to teach; 4) submit a completed Entrance-to-Major application; and 5) provide evidence of having completed at least 6 credits of college-level mathematics, 3 credits of college-level English literature, and 3 credits of college-level English composition.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Secondary Education

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Security and Risk Analysis major, students must: 1) have completed the following entrance-to-major requirements with a grade of C or better: IST 140, SRA 111, MATH 110 or MATH 140, and STAT 200 or SCM 200; and 2) have achieved a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00. Incoming first-year students are admitted directly into the College of Information Sciences and Technology as pre-major students.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Security and Risk Analysis

Requirements: In order to be eligible for entrance to the Social Work major, a student must: 1. Have completed 32.1 or more credits. 2. Have a cumulative GPA of 2.50 or higher. 3. Have completed SOC 1 or SOC 5 with a grade of C or better. 4. Have completed or be enrolled in SW 200W with a grade of C or better. 5. Complete an application for entrance to the B.S.W. program.
Program name: Bachelor of Social Work in Social Work

Requirements: Incoming first-year students are admitted directly to the major. For more information about the admission process, students should visit the Undergraduate Admissions website.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Sociology

Requirements: Incoming freshmen at University Park are admitted directly into the College of the Liberal Arts. For University-wide admission policies, please consult the Undergraduate Education section of this Bulletin. To be eligible for entrance to the Sociology (SOCBS) major, a student must have: attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Sociology

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Spanish major, a student must: 1) have completed at least 29.1 cumulative credits; 2) have a minimum cumulative grade-point average of 2.00.
Program name: Bachelor of Arts in Spanish

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Special Education major, a student must: (1) have completed at least 29.1 credits; (2) have a cumulative grade-point average of at least 3.00 (and maintain it); (3) have completed with a grade of C or better: CI 295 (or equivalent), EDPSY 10 or 11, EDTHP 115, ENGL 15 or 30H, MATH 200; (4) have completed at least 6 credits of university-level English literature and composition and 6 credits of university-level mathematics; (5) documentation of at least 80 hours of volunteer or paid education work with people with disabilities.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Special Education

Requirements: For admission to the University, students must submit a high school transcript or equivalent and meet specific high school unit requirements, including 4 units of English, 3 units of Mathematics, 3 units of Science, 3 units of Social Studies, and 2 units of World Language. For formal entrance to the Statistics (B.S.) major, students must have attained at least a 2.00 cumulative grade-point average and have completed MATH 140, MATH 141, and either STAT 200 or STAT 250 with a grade of C or better in each of these courses.
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Statistics

Requirements: To be eligible for entrance to the Supply Chain and Information Systems (SCIS_BS) major, students must: 1. have completed 44-59 cumulative credits at Penn State (this includes current-semester credits in progress). 2. have completed with a grade of C or better: ACCTG 211, ECON 102, ENGL 15, ENGL 30H, or ESL 15, MATH 110 or MATH 140, and STAT 200 or SCM 200. 3. have achieved a minimum cumulative grade-point average (GPA).
Program name: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain and Information Systems

Requirements: Entrance to the Telecommunications and Media Industries major (formerly Telecommunications) requires that a student have a 2.00 or higher cumulative grade-point average and have completed COMM 100, COMM 160, or COMM 180 with a grade of C or better. For the B.A. degree, a minimum of 120 credits is required, including at least 42 credits in the major.
